name: allele_specific
description: Content resolved to individual alleles, partitioning signal or interactions between the two alleles using phased variants (e.g. an allele-specific contact matrix).

name: haplotype_specific
description: Content computed separately for a specific parental haplotype, i.e. partitioned by haplotype (e.g. haplotype-specific alignments or contact matrix).

name: phased
description: Content with haplotype phase resolved (which alleles co-occur on the same chromosome) without necessarily being split per-haplotype (e.g. phased variant calls, phased mapping).
